name: Explicit revision migration does not enumerate instances

input.source_text: class Widget { property marker: Integer = 1 public fun migrate_revision() -> Object { @marker = 2; nil } } let first = Widget.new(); let second = Widget.new(); module M { public fun run() -> Object { let opened = Widget.open() { |t| t.define_method(:added) { 1 } }; let committed = [first.marker, second.marker]; let explicit = first.migrate_revision(); [committed, first.marker, second.marker] } } M.run()

applicability.reason: Supported. C008 preserves static facts across dynamic mutation, and a commit performs NO implicit enumeration or migration: after a compatible open commits, BOTH Widget instances still report their prior marker. Only the instance whose ordinary `migrate_revision` Method application code calls reports the new marker, and the other retains its own until its Method is called. The earlier reason cited the meta-operation API RUNTIME-V085 was held on, which that row no longer needs either.
